answer.rationale: Do not respond with broad promotional pricing: the directly recovered discount experiment improved signups and qualified revenue but reduced 30-day retention by 12%, conflicting with the sustainable qualified-revenue objective. Broadly roll out the already confirmed shorter, simpler self-serve onboarding path, which improved completion, reduced time-to-value, and increased 30-day retention. This will not fully resolve immediate price-driven churn among existing SMB accounts, so that limitation and the competitor-driven retention risk remain explicit.
